title: Decisions
description: One row per decision, one file per row, append only: `wsc policy` refuses a row changed, moved or removed, and a reversal is a new row whose `replaces` names the old one. Old ids keep their numbers; a new id is minted (`wsc reg add <registry> --mint`), so two branches never share a next number.

reversible.description: yes or no; rows imported from a Markdown table keep the words they had

replaces.description: the rows this one reverses or amends
